plainTranslation: Their familiar patterns land directly on how you present yourself and enter situations, making your usual way of showing up feel quickly recognized and easy to repeat.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
summaryShort: Their familiar patterns land directly on how you present yourself and enter situations, making your usual way of showing up feel quickly recognized and easy to repeat.
summaryDeep: Their familiar patterns land directly on how you present yourself and enter situations, making your usual way of showing up feel quickly recognized and easy to repeat. That recognition can be comfortable, especially when you do not have to explain yourself first. It can also keep both people responding from old expectations; familiarity is not proof of fate or a reason to stay in a role.
